name: Terov
description: Terov is one of the two arches that remained without a mortal keeper after the party completed their keeper assignments. It will stay under temporary stewardship until a future keeper is chosen. The party has not yet visited this arch.

log.summary: **Terov** is one of the two keystone arches that remained without a mortal keeper after the party completed their Gatekeeper assignments on 2026-08-03. Alongside La-rel, it will stay under temporary stewardship until a worthy successor is chosen. The party has not yet visited this arch, so Terov remains an unclaimed realm known only through the Gatekeepers' deliberations rather than direct experience.
